list.title: Products
list.subtitle: Everything you sell. Add a product once and its card and page are made for you.
list.variantsPictures: {variants, plural, one {# variant} other {# variants}}, {pictures, plural, one {# picture} other {# pictures}}
list.loadFailed: The products could not be loaded. Please try again.

editor.newDescription: Start with the basics. After saving you can add variants, stock and pictures.
editor.loadFailed: The product could not be loaded. Please try again.
editor.fixErrors: Please fix the fields marked in red.
editor.created: Product created. Now add its variants and pictures.

done.unpublish: The product is back to draft.

editor.archivedNotice: This product is archived and cannot be changed.
editor.readOnly: You can look at this product but not change it.
editor.previewHint: The card customers will see, updated as you type.
editor.beforePublish: Before this product can go live:
editor.readyToPublish: Everything needed is in place. You can publish it.
editor.liveNotice: This product is live on the storefront.
editor.archiveDescription: It disappears from the storefront and can no longer be edited. Orders and stock history are kept.
editor.deleteDescription: The draft and its variants are removed from the lists. Orders and stock history are never lost.
editor.duplicateDescription: A copy is made as a draft, with its variants (new SKUs) and pictures.

form.slugHint: Leave empty to make it from the name. Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.
form.shortDescriptionHint: One short line shown on the product card.
form.tagsHint: Words separated by commas, used for search.
form.pricingHint: Prices include tax. A sale price runs between its dates, or always when no dates are set.
form.salePriceHint: Must be lower than the regular price.
form.costPriceHint: Only people with permission can see this. Used for profit reports.
form.labelsHint: Shown as badges and used for shop sections.
form.isNewHint: Shows a New badge on the card.
form.isFeaturedHint: Can appear in the featured part of the home page.
form.isBestSellerHint: Can appear in the best sellers part of the home page.
form.deliveryHint: Weight and size are used to work out the delivery charge and courier booking.
form.sizeChartHint: Shown as the size guide on the product page.
form.seoHint: How the product looks in search results and when shared. Leave empty to use the name and tagline.
form.videoUrlHint: A link to a short video, for example on YouTube.
form.nameTooLong: The name can have at most 200 characters.
form.slugInvalid: Use lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens.
form.amountInvalid: Enter an amount with digits and at most two decimals, for example 1250.50.
form.saleBelowRegular: The sale price must be lower than the regular price.
form.saleNeedsPrice: Enter a sale price or clear the sale dates.
form.saleEndAfterStart: The sale must end on or after the day it starts.
form.urlInvalid: Enter a link that starts with http:// or https://.

variants.title: Variants
variants.subtitle: Each colour and size combination has its own SKU. Stock is kept per variant in every branch.
variants.none: No variants yet. A product needs at least one active variant before it can be published.
variants.skuHint: Letters, digits, hyphen, underscore or dot. Unique across the shop.
variants.priceOverrideHint: Leave empty to use the product price.
variants.dialogHint: Colour and size are shown to customers as swatches and size chips.
variants.generateHint: List the colours and sizes; one variant is made for every pair. Combinations that already exist are skipped.
variants.skuPrefixHint: Each SKU is this text, three letters of the colour and the size, for example JV-TEE-BLK-M.
variants.coloursListHint: Separated by commas. Common colour names get a swatch automatically.
variants.sizesListHint: Separated by commas, for example S, M, L, XL or 39, 40, 41.
variants.nothingToMake: Enter at least one colour or size to see what will be made.
variants.willMake: {count, plural, one {# variant will be made} other {# variants will be made}}
variants.generated: {count, plural, one {# variant made.} other {# variants made.}}
variants.generatedPartly: {count, plural, one {# variant was made before the problem.} other {# variants were made before the problem.}}
variants.removeDescription: {sku} is removed from the product and its SKU is free to use again. A variant that still has stock cannot be removed.

stock.title: Stock by branch
stock.subtitle: Set how many you have in each branch. The difference is booked in the stock history.
stock.noVariants: Add variants first, then their stock appears here.
stock.pending: {count, plural, =0 {No changes yet} one {# change to save} other {# changes to save}}

images.title: Pictures
images.rules: JPEG, PNG or WebP, at least 1000 pixels on the longer side, up to 10 MB each. Pictures are resized and cropped to the 4:5 card automatically. The first picture is the card picture.
images.uploadColourHint: Optional. Pictures with a colour show with that colour's variants.
images.errorType: This is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP picture.
images.errorSize: The file is larger than 10 MB.
images.errorSmall: The picture is {width} x {height} pixels; it must be at least 1000 pixels on the longer side.
images.uploaded: {count, plural, one {# picture uploaded.} other {# pictures uploaded.}}
images.none: No pictures yet. A product needs at least one picture before it can be published.
images.deleteDescription: The picture and its resized copies are removed.
images.focalHint: Click the picture (or use the sliders) to choose the centre of the card crop. The frame shows what the card will show.
